items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: when I came out here and I got to see him and got to know him

ctx.x: I remember this very well. And then later on, of course, you know, when I came out here and I got to see him and got to know him -- he didn't know me then, you know. He didn't know -- they would just come to Lake Charles and play there a couple of days and they'd be on their way, you know. But I did get a chance to see people like these people.
So you came to Los Angeles, then, in 1935, is that right?
